<?php

require __DIR__.'/vendor/autoload.php';
$app = require_once __DIR__.'/bootstrap/app.php';
$app->make(Illuminate\Contracts\Console\Kernel::class)->bootstrap();

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

$student = User::where('role', 'student')->whereNotNull('program_id')->first();
echo 'Student: '.($student?->name ?? 'none').PHP_EOL;
echo 'college_id: '.($student?->program?->college_id ?? 'none').PHP_EOL;

$collegeId = $student?->program?->college_id;

echo 'Counselors assigned to that college: '.User::where('role', 'counselor')
    ->whereHas('colleges', fn ($q) => $q->where('colleges.id', $collegeId))->count().PHP_EOL;
echo 'Total active counselors: '.User::where('role', 'counselor')->where('is_active', true)->count().PHP_EOL;
echo 'Counselor-college links: '.DB::table('college_counselor')->count().PHP_EOL;
echo 'Students with null program_id: '.User::where('role', 'student')->whereNull('program_id')->count().PHP_EOL;
